title: Prevent creation of overlapping rent records for same item
gherkin:
Feature: Overlap Prevention Rule
  Scenario: System rejects overlapping rent creation
    Given an item with an existing Active rent from 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-10
    When a user attempts to create a new rent for the same item from 2026-03-05 to 2026-03-15
    Then the system shall reject the rent creation
    And an error message shall indicate the period overlaps with an existing rent
rationale: The overlap prevention rule must prevent creation of rent records with overlapping periods for the same item. This is the core requirement to maintain data integrity and prevent double-booking.
usedContextItems: Overlap prevention rule|prevent overlapping rent periods|rental periods

Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)

    Given an item with an Active rent from 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-10

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
